steps.sub: one Ingress, routed by path to both services

code:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: Deployment
    name: checkout-checkout
  minReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.minReplicas }}
  maxReplicas: {{ .Values.autoscaling.maxReplicas }}
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target: { averageUtilization: 70 }
caption: scaleTargetRef ties the HPA to checkout's Deployment specifically, not product-catalog's.

eyebrow: Install, verify, then prove upgrade and rollback both work
code:
helm lint ./charts/checkout
helm install checkout ./charts/checkout --values values-prod.yaml

kubectl get pods,ingress,hpa -n northbridge-retail

helm upgrade checkout ./charts/checkout --set image.tag=1.6.0
helm rollback checkout 1
caption: A Pod stuck not-Running? Back to lesson 34: kubectl describe pod, then kubectl logs.
